name: b4-truncated-context-nonempty
title: B4 truncatedContext: non-empty context-lost marker so single-shot agent gets a valid prompt
description: Fix B4 context-loss so the turn-1 truncation hands the single-shot claude -p agent a non-empty token-less context-lost marker (mirroring B5.checkpointContext) instead of an empty prompt that yields infra-fail, keeping the disk-grounded classify and the hermetic self-check green, so the honest powered re-run produces a real B4 outcome for the paper recovery table.
